inputs.project_context: Original analytical worked example for MechanismFigures; not empirical research.
inputs.mechanism: Explain why Euclidean projection onto x >= 0 preserves the tangential component rather than shrinking the whole vector.

evidence.supports: Specified analytic formula and displayed coordinates; check_math verifies representative and boundary cases.
evidence.does_not_support: No novelty, measured runtime, population effect, biological inference, or cross-agent quality claim.

output_constraints.audience: Domain-competent scientist unfamiliar with the example
output_constraints.accessibility: Meaning must survive grayscale; use direct labels and geometry.

analysis.insight: The nearest feasible point removes the forbidden normal component and leaves the tangent unchanged.
assumptions: Euclidean metric; equal axis scales; feasible halfspace x >= 0.
analysis.claim_boundary: This is one elementary halfspace projection, not a general convergence result.
analysis.falsifier: A changed y coordinate or a shorter feasible displacement would contradict the depicted projection.

candidates.construction: Draw input, feasible halfspace and orthogonal correction at equal scale.
candidates.visible_gain: The removed component and unchanged tangent can be traced.
candidates.distortion_risk: Unequal axis scales would distort perpendicularity.

candidates.construction: Align before/after coordinates and annotate the scalar truncation.
candidates.visible_gain: Direct equality of the y coordinate.

encoding.visual: Arrows from the same origin; dashed input, solid projected result

reference_readings.insight: When indices hide relational structure, draw the objects they refer to and preserve the direction of each dependency.
reference_readings.do_not_copy: Do not draw triangles merely because the method contains three modules.
reference_readings.access_note: Actual figure visually inspected; non-bundled references were inspected from a cached original-source image, not a generated stand-in.

reference_readings.insight: Put the error and its repair in the same coordinates; preserve the target across the counterfactual.
reference_readings.do_not_copy: Do not show improvement by silently moving or simplifying the target.
reference_readings.access_note: Actual figure visually inspected; non-bundled references were inspected from a cached original-source image, not a generated stand-in.

reading_path: Find the infeasible vector outside x >= 0.
Follow the orthogonal correction to the boundary.

prediction_probe.question: Which component remains unchanged under this projection?

counterfactual_probe.question: What happens if the input already has x >= 0?

reproduction.command: python3 render.py --kind projection --output . && node preview.mjs figure.svg figure.png
reproduction.environment: Python 3.9.6 standard library; optional preview: Node 26.8.2 and installed Chrome on macOS. SVG/data regeneration is independent of Chrome. QA derivatives: 680×397 px physical-size proxy at 96 CSS dpi, generated by the same installed Chrome; grayscale conversion via MuPDF 1.26.0. These are inspection derivatives, not extra scientific data.
